title: Creamy Pilaf with Chickpeas
description: A keto version of a classic pilaf dish, made creamy and flavorful with chickpeas. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pilaf and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add the chickpeas and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the wholesome and melted creamy.
Pour the creamy mixture over the chickpea and pilaf mixture.
Stir to combine and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
